correctness.rationale: On a complete tripartite graph the dynamics depend only on three nonempty four-color support sets and individual initial color representatives; 15^3=3375 exhaustive decorated cases prove F7=F3 for arbitrarily large shore sizes. Recurrent microscopic periods are exactly 1 and 4, with sharp three-step entry witnessed on K112. Surjections weighted by shore cardinality provide the full 16-term coefficient formula; independent exhaustive quotient matched 54 fixed and 619 4-period supports.
residual_risks: The 3375 cases form an exhaustive finite quotient for arbitrary shore sizes, because same-shore/same-initial-color vertices evolve together. Keeping decorated representatives is essential to detect microscopic periods correctly.
